title: S4 project directives: duplicate propulsion, disable craft at a distance

tellings.quote: directive was duplicate the propulsion system at any cost is directive one and directive two was be able to disable the system at a distance at any cost.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S4 in 1988 and 1989, tells Michels the project had two orders. The first was to "duplicate the propulsion system at any cost". The second was to "be able to disable the system at a distance at any cost". If true, the government wanted both to copy the craft and to be able to bring them down.
